note: K = packages/agent-ui/a2ui/tools/testkit (library, data, CLI, and the Node-only tests kit.test.ts and load.test.ts, which run in the node-environment `tools` vitest project through ONE explicit include line). L = packages/agent-ui/a2ui/src/testkit (vitest legs only; jsdom legs match the existing `packages` glob, browser legs match the existing `packages-rest` glob). Rule: files under L import only the DOM-safe modules of K plus load.vite.ts, never load.node.ts, kit.ts or pins. Build base: origin/main with PR #1824 (no barrels) merged.
